operators.contract: Head-stage container; runs partition zero, prepares tasks and waits for distributed execution. Base-plan properties are retained.
Caches each input stream once and exposes one copy per consumer task: output = input_partitions * consumer_tasks.
Displayed as DistributedUnionExec. Child-local task contexts select active branches; output capacity is maximum assigned child-partition sum, padded with empty streams.
Selects a prebuilt leaf variant by effective task index. With one task executes original. Inline displays retain original labels; printed variants are specialized before drawing.
Display and children delegate to inner operator; merges metrics only. Not a separately displayed dataflow node; execute is unimplemented.
Each consumer requests Q partitions from every producer; Q = partitions_per_consumer. stage_partitions=0 means remote plan metadata unavailable, not zero output.
Contiguous balanced producer groups; output capacity = producer partitions * max(ceil(producers/consumers),1); shorter groups expose empty padding.
Direct: Q streams per producer-consumer pair. Two-phase: one stream per pair, one receiver output per producer. Counts distinguish modes; missing evidence stays unresolved.
Samples/buffers for adaptive planning, then returns the buffered stream and continuation. Retains input partitioning and ordering; partitions= prints sampler count.
Drains distributed execution and collects worker metrics into one EXPLAIN result stream. Colonless verbose= formatting is recognized.
Configurable partition count is not printed. Retain generic box and unknown count unless a consumer contract establishes capacity.
Printed partitions is advertised capacity, including possible empty slots; emits worker URL and task/partition identity.
Work-feed operations generate rows. Scaling uses integer division of global partition_ops length by effective task count; operation count is not stream count.
One partition per task; task index selects a numeric range. Range count is not local partition count.
One cached or child stream per partition; preserves schema, partitioning and ordering.
Work-feed source: floor(global chunk-list count / effective task count) after scaling, global count before scaling. Inner values are row counts. Missing worker context remains unknown.
Copies child partition properties; execution checks a custom configuration extension and may fail.
Custom codec example forwarding child partitions with copied partition properties.
Copies child partition capacity but execution produces an error stream; capacity does not imply successful execution or rows.
Stores asynchronous forwarding state; partition properties copied from child.

legacy.contract: tasks=T partitions=P prints global child P; per-task output capacity ceil(P/T), contiguous selection and empty padding. Verbose-only mapping without counts remains metadata-limited.
